test_title: PYST 54: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following platforms are integrated under the National Cooperation Policy, 2025, to promote digital commerce for cooperatives?

options.text: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market) and e-Shram Portal
GeM (Government e-Marketplace) and ONDC (Open Network for Digital Commerce)

solution:
The correct answer is __**GeM (Government e-Marketplace) and ONDC (Open Network for Digital Commerce)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **National Cooperation Policy, 2025** is a comprehensive framework designed to provide a new direction to the cooperative movement in **India**, aiming to fulfill the vision of **"Sahakar se Samriddhi"** (Prosperity through Cooperation).
 
• One of the primary objectives of the policy is the **digital transformation** of cooperatives, which includes their integration with the **Government e-Marketplace (GeM)**. This allows cooperative societies to register as sellers, providing them direct access to **government procurement** worth billions of rupees.
 
• The policy also emphasizes integration with the **Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC)**. This initiative enables cooperatives to list their products on an open network, ensuring they are not restricted to a single e-commerce platform and can reach **consumers** nationwide.
